manualScopeReview.scope: Observed visit counts, sampled opinions and pending decisions remain distinct; current summary task uses a new 40/12/9 scenario while no-question teaching references use original 30/10/8.
Sleep or interest is a possible compatible confound, not a proven true cause; random assignment does not cure an extra-time implementation difference.
Error bounds are explicit model inputs, not inferred from display precision; overlapping intervals establish non-guarantee, not actual equality.
Temperature and water both change in flawed comparison; controlled follow-up addresses the actual confound, not a student personality claim.
Counterexample possibility does not assert actual card existence; only biconditional rules allow reverse implication.
Rate addition is always conditional on independent, constant, nonoverlapping work; Chinese fraction wording corrected to 三分之四小时 before final use.
A resource constraint changes feasible overlap; dependencies and elapsed time are checked separately.
Nonnegative real variables are explicit; integer restriction is checked only where introduced.
Nonmedical quality screening uses complete artificial counts; changed-batch calculation explicitly assumes conditional rates stable.
